system.description:
Hardened in the brutal tribal warfare of Tariel's desert wastelands — raids, ambushes, endurance.

  • Ambush Strike: Advantage on your first attack roll each round against a target that hasn't yet acted in combat.
  • Desert Born: Advantage on Survival checks in arid or desert terrain, and on checks identifying Red Waste tribal markings or customs.
